sermon.title: Order from Chaos: Put Away Childishness
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: A short message on how Satan causes destruction by attacking the family, with statistics on fatherless homes. Having children or marrying doesn’t make anyone a good parent or spouse; men and women must become wise, keep sexual desire within marriage and put away childish things.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Short excerpt (about 5 minutes). He cites “Proverbs 5:15” and reads on through verses 18–19 and 22.

chunks.short_answer: America is big on being beautiful on the outside, but inside we are immature with no fear of the Lord; sexual desire belongs in the marriage God set up.

Let them be only your own, And not for strangers with you. Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth. faqs.question: Where did the fatherless statistics come from?
faqs.answer: He says he looked them up real quick; they are United States figures.

faqs.question: What share of homeless and runaway children are from fatherless homes?
What does he say about youth in prison?
faqs.answer: He says 85% come from fatherless homes.

faqs.question: Does marrying make someone a good spouse?
faqs.answer: No; any woman can marry a man and most men can produce children, but that doesn’t make them good spouses or parents.

faqs.question: What happens if we act like fools?
faqs.answer: He says a fool is going to cause destruction.

faqs.question: What does Proverbs 5 tell men?
faqs.answer: Drink water from your own cistern; you shouldn’t be sleeping around.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Drink water from your own cistern, And running water from your own well. Should your fountains be dispersed abroad, Streams of water in the streets? Let them be only your own, And not for strangers with you. Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth. As a loving deer and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; And always be enraptured with her love.

faqs.question: What is wrong with doing what we want?
faqs.answer: We want to do what we want regardless of the consequences, with no fear of the Lord to depart from evil.

faqs.question: Does he have children?
faqs.answer: He says he has three children.

faqs.question: Is it only toddlers who make a mess?
faqs.answer: No, teenagers too; you go in the bathroom and wonder what just happened.
